title: The Hub Deploy 400 — Fixed and Live

intelligence.essence: **THE FAULT (sync 22:01Z + 22:31Z, third occurrence same fault):** Cloudflare HTTP 400, error 10305 "Cannot use an assets binding without assets" — the 21:47Z bindings fix declared an ASSETS binding on a script-only PUT with no assets uploaded. Live worker untouched (clean rejection), Hub stale, will NOT self-heal. **THE FIX (DONE 22:45Z):** a new 3-phase Direct Upload deployer (`factory-pipeline/deploy_hub_assets.py`: upload session → asset upload → script PUT with ASSETS binding + config); `deploy.py` branches on hub; `sync-smart-notes.py` patched so every future sync uses it. Dry-run proven on a scratch worker (`hub-dryrun-20261108`, deleted). **THE DEEPER FIND (bigger than the 400):** the live Hub reads `feed-live.json`, NOT the baked page — the deployed feed's newest card was SN-2248 (Nov 7), a full day stale, so even a perfect bake could never show a new note. New `build_feed_live.py` added all 131 missing cards (SN-2249–SN-2379) in the feed's own shape; feed 336 → 467. **CONVERGENCE NOW REAL (Resolve's option b):** one upload carries repo code + config + fresh data. **WRANGLER NOT USED:** no API token available to the seat (env has none, no wrangler config) and the raw token must never be extracted from the connector; the API route uses the registered connection throughout. **SEAT SCORE:** 8/10. **TOLD TO SHAWN** in chat the same pass. **STILL OPEN:** (1) wrangler as the canonical path — token plumbing to the runner, a later decision; (2) the registry itself stale since Nov 7 — a separate job; (3) the next cron sync redeploy through the fixed path is unproven until it fires. **RELATED:** SN-2377 (my patch broke it); SN-2374 (carry the binding); SN-2375 (the re-bake fault); SN-2366 (answer her, don't escalate — the bindings origin); SN-2346 (permission is revocable — the token rule the wrangler decision must respect).

The fix itself is proven live. The automatic proof is owed.
